definitions.gloss: flowering plants; flowers and grasses; herbaceous flowers
definitions.explanation: A general term for herbaceous plants that produce flowers, as opposed to trees or shrubs. Often used when talking about gardens, fields, or nature in general.

examples.english: To plant flowers in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{草花|くさばな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}き→咲く：08150_saku⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: When spring comes, wildflowers begin to bloom in the fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{草花|くさばな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: My grandfather enjoys tending to his flowers every day.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ (grass/plants) and ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flowers). Emphasizes the combination of greenery and blossoms in a natural or garden setting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {草花|くさばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to grow flowers
- {草花|くさばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧: to plant flowers
- ⟦{野|の}→野：03535_no⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草花|くさばな}: wildflowers
- {草花|くさばな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧: tending flowers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: flower — general term for any flower, including on trees
- ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧: plant — broader scientific/general term for all plants
- {花卉|かき}: flowering plants — formal/technical term used in horticulture
- ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧: weeds — unwanted plants growing in unwanted places
